raw_text: Planet Labs SkySat imagery from August 12 shows a PLAN Type 093 Shang-class nuclear attack submarine on the surface approximately 340 nautical miles southeast of Sri Lanka in the eastern Indian Ocean. The submarine appeared to be conducting a brief surface transit before diving. This is the first confirmed sighting of a Chinese SSN this far west in the Indian Ocean in 2024. The location is consistent with anti-submarine warfare patrol routes in the Bay of Bengal approaches.
